title: The 5 biggest cybersecurity threats of 2026 that nobody is prepared for

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What cybersecurity threats in 2026 will catch us off guard, despite our best efforts?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Quantum computing could break current encryption, and AI-driven deepfakes may fool even biometric systems.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: If AI-generated disinformation becomes indistinguishable from truth, trust in institutions may collapse.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: We're developing post-quantum cryptography and AI detection tools to combat synthetic media at scale.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: With global cooperation on AI ethics, we might see a world where truth is preserved and protected.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future depends on balancing innovation with responsibility, preparing for what we cannot yet imagine.

video_cue: A holographic interface displaying real-time global cyber threat maps with AI alerts.
